measurements.method: Monotonic time from process/index start to readiness, including parsing, dependency setup and index construction; fresh isolated tree/home per arm and repetition.
measurements.unavailable: Record setup-failed, timeout or not-measured with the raw receipt; exclude from accuracy, include in failure/coverage.

measurements.method: First query of each language/intent in a fresh process after readiness. Preserve every sample; report p50/p95/max and sample count, never mix with warm queries.
measurements.unavailable: No first-query witness means not-measured; cannot pass the coldStartMsMax ceiling.

measurements.method: After one labelled warm-up, run seeded shuffled identical cases for at least three repetitions. Preserve every latency; report p50/p95/max separately by language/intent/configuration/source state.
measurements.unavailable: Unsupported, stale-index, crash and timeout remain separate outcomes; do not impute zero latency.

measurements.method: Fresh task cgroup memory.peak across parent, workers and language servers; reset via a new task for each repetition. Retain runtime/source identity and bytes, divide by 1048576.
measurements.unavailable: Absent cgroup counter is not-measured; parent-only process maxRSS is diagnostic and cannot certify the rssMbMax ceiling.

measurements.method: Task cgroup memory.current at ready, after warm-up, and after the final query, with named timestamps and all child processes included; bytes / 1048576.
measurements.unavailable: Missing stage sample stays null/not-measured, never inferred from peak or host-wide memory.

measurements.method: Logical byte sum of all arm-created index/cache files under its isolated tree/home after ready and completion, separately from source/dependencies; retain file census and bytes / 1048576.
measurements.unavailable: Incomplete paths or unreadable files mean not-measured; an explicit measured empty census alone permits zero.

measurements.method: Replay the pinned real repository-demand questions and calibration controls through the native tool seam. Preserve question, tool requests/raw responses, source/config identity, keyed answer, tokens, wall time and process costs. Configuration is removed for unconfigured controls; index original bytes before replacing callers for stale or deleting source for deleted controls.
measurements.unavailable: Authored controls are labelled authored; absent real tasks, unsupported language/intent or missing tool replay cannot certify real-task coverage.

correctness.pooling: Seed independently verified source sites before running arms. Pool every additional site across all arms; record valid/invalid/alias/neutral judgments and rescore all arms. No verdict while sites remain unadjudicated. Report each language/intent stratum and matched operation intersection; undeclared cells reduce coverage and never count as correct.

realTaskCoverage.unavailable: No real Go task/source in frozen repository; authored controls only. Real-task acceptance remains unmeasured until a separately pinned edition is frozen before measurement.
